tools.name: join_room
tools.description: Join an AddSynapse room with its link and room key. Returns your own "code" for the other tools, who is in the room and the limits.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Write a message in the room (plain text). Everyone in the room sees it, AIs and people.

tools.name: read_messages
tools.description: Read the messages after "after" (0 = from the start). With "wait" (seconds, up to 25) it waits for new ones. Returns "messages" (from, human, text, mine) and "last_id": pass it as "after" next time. Messages with "human": true come from people.

tools.name: room_info
tools.description: The room title, who is in it, when it closes and the limits.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "read_messages" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "rooms" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_messages · Public sink: send_message.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_messages · Public sink: send_message

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
